figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

choice: Cued reading, 1-s covert preparation, then overt articulation
M01.note: Inherited from the group's MEG paradigm.

choice: ImageNet-pretrained AlexNet, ResNet101, Inception-ResNet-v2; no from-scratch control
M03.note: New at the time; effect of pretraining untested.

choice: 1-s preparation interval between text and speech
Morlet scalograms per sensor or as 14 × 14 mosaic into CNNs; RMS-feature ANN baseline
M06.field: Hand-crafted features + shallow classifier, 13 of 16 prior
M06.note: Time-frequency image CNN in 0 of 16 priors; representation and classifier change together (authors, Sec. 5.1); mosaic not better for imagination.

choice: Three random 70/15/15 trial splits within subject; pre-stimulus above chance
M12.note: Matches usual practice; pre-stimulus 43.77% (AlexNet, Table 1) vs 20% theoretical chance, reported by the authors.

M13.note: Authors call MEG unsuitable for deployment (Sec. 5.4).
